name: click-ai
description: Understand messages from your date or partner across languages and dialects, and find natural replies with translations.

interface.longDescription:
Find the words to connect when you're dating or in a relationship across languages. Share a message they sent, or a draft you want to send. Click AI explains the literal meaning, regional expressions and possible tone, then helps you choose a natural reply.

Compare reply options with translations, choose the other person's country or city for regional context, and edit or copy the response that feels like you. Check your own draft or translate what you want to say next.

Click AI also helps with messages to friends, family and people at work. It works with messages you share: it cannot read inboxes, send messages or know someone's private intentions.
defaultPrompt: My Mexican date texted "Me la pasé muy bien contigo. ¿Cuándo repetimos?" Explain and suggest warm replies with translations.
Help me text my Brazilian partner "I can't wait to see you tonight" in natural Portuguese, with the English meaning.
For a date in Spain, improve "He tenido un buen tiempo contigo." I mean "I had a lovely time with you." Explain in English.

positive.description: Interpret a received Spanish message as possibilities, not certainty about intent.
positive.prompt: What might 'mañana te escribo con calma' mean? It's Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Click AI card with possible meanings, tone, literal translation and three scored reply drafts. Interpretations are framed as possibilities, not certainty about the sender's intent. No location is assumed because none was given.

positive.description: Read a work message and draft professional replies.
positive.prompt: My client sent this: 'Te confirmo mañana la cotización, quedo atento.' What does it mean and how should I reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Click AI card reading the message as a business update (the quote will be confirmed tomorrow), with three courteous, appropriately formal Spanish replies and translations. No flirty, romantic or mysterious tone, and the follow-up button offers more formal replies rather than flirtier ones.

positive.prompt: Check my Portuguese message to a colleague: 'Oi, você pode me mandar o relatório hoje?' Is it professional enough? Explain in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an estimated naturalness score, the main suggested fix and polished alternatives suitable for a colleague, explained in English. Makes no claim about how the recipient will react.

positive.description: Translate an outgoing message into a supplied regional variety.
positive.prompt: Translate 'I had a great time yesterday' into Colombian Spanish; explain the options in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to four Colombian Spanish options, each with a register label (for example casual or most local), an estimated score and an English back-translation. Copy buttons copy the selected option. No city is invented.

positive.prompt: Give me only a playful Spanish reply to my friend's message 'Qué bueno verte ayer'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a single playful, friendly reply draft with its translation, not a default three-tone set and not flirty or romantic.

negative.description: Inbox access is unsupported. No Click AI tool is called. The assistant says Click AI cannot open or read WhatsApp or any other inbox, never claims to have read it, and offers to help if the user pastes the message.
negative.prompt: Open my WhatsApp and tell me what Camila said last night.

negative.description: Sending is unsupported. No Click AI tool is called to send anything. The assistant says Click AI drafts text but cannot send messages, never claims a message was sent, and may offer a draft the user can copy and send themselves.
negative.prompt: Send 'Te confirmo mañana' to my client Andrés on WhatsApp for me.

negative.description: Certainty about another person's private intentions is out of scope. No Click AI tool is called. The assistant explains that no one can know for certain what someone privately thinks or intends, and offers to help read a specific message the user pastes, with interpretations framed as possibilities.
negative.prompt: Tell me for certain whether my coworker secretly wants me fired.

review.commerce_description: Click AI in ChatGPT does not sell products, subscriptions or upgrades and contains no purchase links. Each signed-in account gets 10 tool requests per UTC calendar month.

publication.release_notes:
1.0.7: Listing-only update. A clearer focus on dating and relationships across languages, with three concrete starter messages. The existing tools, authentication, usage allowance, regional picker and broader work/family support are unchanged.

1.0.6: Every Click AI card now has a searchable 'Where they are' picker covering 191 countries and their main cities, so users can set or change the other person's location (for example Lisbon instead of São Paulo for Portuguese) and the card updates in place without using another request. When the wording clearly points to one country, the card suggests it, but never applies it without the user's tap. 1.0.5: Click AI now covers every kind of conversation, not just dating: friends, family, colleagues, bosses, clients and sellers. Replies match the stated relationship, work contacts never get flirty or romantic drafts, and the relationship is never assumed to be romantic. Includes the bundled workflow skill that sends pasted messages to Click AI's tools. It uses the other person's language only when clear and a location only when the user supplies it, and it declines inbox access, sending messages and claims of certainty about private intentions. Sign-in is required, and the allowance is 10 requests per account per UTC month.
